summary: {member} asks what will pay for affordable classes when residents are asked to renew the parks levy.
realLife: Portland's 2025 ballot materials linked levy renewal to continuing free and discounted programs, and voters approved the five-year measure.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
inGame: The park fee series supplies the jurisdiction's change in the charge level. needs: a levy referral, operating forecast and commitment to discounted recreation.

turns.pulledBy: A higher participation fee would replace part of the tax support.
turns.what: The member asks staff to price the increase for a family using a discount.
turns.writesBack: The hearing records the family's net charge.

turns.pulledBy: The proposed levy supports lower prices.
turns.what: The member asks which activities the appropriation can keep affordable.
turns.writesBack: The budget records the activities covered by the commitment.
